description: Searches events and local places on Viventii across cities, dates, categories, keywords, budgets, and accessibility. Always returns verified city hub URLs alongside matching listings.

categories.description: Optional categories (e.g. Music, Parties, Art, Food, Theater, Sports, Outdoors, Family, Shopping, Education, Fairs)
